sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay of Penguin Splash revolves around creating groups of three or more penguins of the same color. This can be done in a variety of ways, including horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. When a group of penguins is created, they will splash, clearing the board and earning points. The game also features a variety of special power-ups, including the ability to swap two penguins, remove all penguins of a specific color, and more.

The game's mechanics are easy to understand, but challenging to master. As you progress through the levels, you'll need to think strategically about which penguins to create and when to use your power-ups.
